descriptionsByVersion.v1.5:
Mod head pack for Facial Animation. Requires the Genetic Heads Framework for [NL] Facial Animation.
Adds genetic Facial Animation support for a few different mods. Art is slightly modified from the original mods to allow Facial Animation compatibility. Guy762 was kind enough to provide blank head textures.
Current Supported Mods: - Vanilla Races Expanded - Android - Vanilla Races Expanded - Genie - Vanilla Races Expanded - Insector - Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin - Vanilla Races Expanded - Saurid - Roo's Faun Xenotype - Guy762's Star Wars Xenotypes
